correctness.rationale: For each ordering pattern of <=k atoms for each of n independent non-tied real variables, ranking probabilities are polynomial in <=n(k-1) free masses. Only finitely many interleavings occur, proving semialgebraic dimension <=n(k-1). Fix distinct baseline atoms at positions 1..n and choose one or two alternative atoms per label. A single alternative deviation produces a nonidentity permutation sigma_ij. At all-alternative-masses-zero, the Jacobian columns are e_sigma-e_identity. The exhibited binary relocation permutations are pairwise distinct for every n>=4, as are the 2n ternary relocations; a full-rank minor at zero persists into the strict positive mass chamber. Thus dim A_n,2=n and dim A_n,3=2n. Independent generation of the explicit insertion patterns verified all nonidentity distinctness for n=4..60, which corroborates the general structural proof.
